abstract.text: Choose a Project and browse its saved places and Items.

inlineContent.text: Choose Project in the sidebar. The panel is titled Projects.
Sign in if requested, then wait for the list to load.
Enter part of a name in Find a project if you need to narrow the list.
Choose a Project and wait for its map data to load.

The first Project opens automatically when the list loads. Projects are listed newest first. A Shared badge identifies Projects shared with you that you have already accepted. To change Projects, choose another name in the list.
On a phone, choosing a Project closes the panel to reveal the map. Choose Project again to browse its records.
Under Browse project, choose Project details to see whether the Project is private or shared and the counts of its Locations, Regions, Layers, and Items. Choose a count to open that list.

You can also open Locations, Regions, Layers, or Items directly under Browse project. Choose a record to inspect it. Back returns through related details, and Close details closes the panel. You can continue using the map while details are open.
for the information available in each list.

content.text: Create, edit, or share a Project

inlineContent.text: Use LinkMap for iOS to create, rename, edit, delete, or share a Project and to accept invitations. The web app only displays Projects your signed-in account can access; it has no permission-management or invitation-acceptance controls.
After a change in iOS, use Refresh map data for the selected Project, or reload the page to update the Projects list. See
if a Project is missing or cannot load.
